- Overestimate prices in bullish sentiment periods (sentiment > 0.67) — reduce forecast peak by 2–5% to avoid overshoot.
- Underestimate prices in bearish sentiment (sentiment < 0.33) — add 1–3% to forecast to avoid underreaction.
- Lagged price movements (e.g., 3–5 day delays in forecast response) — adjust forecast to align with recent 3–7 day trend, not 18-day history.
- When sentiment shifts sharply upward, reduce forecast slope to avoid overcorrection after spikes.
- Mean-reversion bias: if forecast is >10% above recent 5-day average, reduce by 1–3% per day until convergence.
- Horizon-specific: 30-day forecasts often overreact to short-term sentiment — dampen forecast volatility by 15–20% if sentiment is volatile or mixed.
